title: Suspend a graph for durable human approval
narrative: High-consequence steps must pause on a durable approval interrupt with evidence, timeout policy, and actor provenance — then resume when a human decides. Accepts WalkingLabs P08 and L14 guidance[^wl-p08-approval][^wl-l14-approval].
implementation: `ApprovalInterrupt`, `suspend_for_approval`, and `resume_approval` in `mechaharness.approval_interrupt` model pending/approved/rejected interrupts with checkpoint refs.
validation: Kind `approval_interrupt_cycle`. Soft expects pending then approved with actor.
